title: Language Model Interfaces
summary: This module defines the core interfaces and components for interacting with language models, covering message representation, prompt construction, model implementations, and output parsing. It provides the foundational building blocks for any LLM-powered application in LangChain.

nodes.label: Abstract Language Model Interface
nodes.title: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for all language models (LLMs), providing methods for text generation and interaction.

nodes.label: Abstract Chat Model Interface
nodes.title: Base Chat Model Interface
nodes.description: Extends the base language model interface for conversational AI, handling message lists and chat-specific interactions.

nodes.label: Concrete Model Implementations
nodes.title: Concrete LLM/Chat Models
nodes.description: Actual implementations of language models, including fake models for testing and integrations with various LLM providers.

nodes.label: Abstract Message Interface
nodes.title: Base Message Abstraction
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental structure for all message types (e.g., Human, AI, System) in conversational contexts.

nodes.label: Standard Message Content Blocks
nodes.title: Message Content Blocks
nodes.description: Standardized representations for various types of content within messages, such as text, images, and tool calls.

nodes.label: Message Utility Functions
nodes.title: Message Utilities
nodes.description: Helper functions for manipulating messages, including token counting, filtering, merging, and chat history management.

nodes.label: Abstract Prompt Template Interface
nodes.title: Base Prompt Template
nodes.description: Defines the abstract base for all prompt templates, enabling dynamic construction and formatting of inputs for language models.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Templates
nodes.title: Chat-Specific Prompt Templates
nodes.description: Templates designed for constructing prompts in conversational settings, often composed of a sequence of message prompt templates.

nodes.label: String Prompt Templates
nodes.title: String-Based Prompt Templates
nodes.description: Templates for creating simple string-based prompts, allowing for variable substitution and formatting.

nodes.label: Abstract Output Parser Interface
nodes.title: Base Output Parser
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for parsing raw language model outputs into structured and usable formats.

nodes.label: Structured Output Parsers
nodes.title: Specific Output Parsers
nodes.description: Concrete implementations of output parsers that convert LLM text into structured data like lists, XML, or Pydantic objects.

groups.label: Language Model Core
groups.title: Core Language Model Definitions
groups.description: This group encompasses the fundamental interfaces and concrete implementations for interacting with various types of language models.

groups.label: Message Handling
groups.title: Conversational Message Management
groups.description: This group focuses on the representation, construction, and utility functions for managing messages within conversational AI systems.

groups.label: Prompt Engineering
groups.title: Prompt Construction & Formatting
groups.description: This group provides the tools and templates for building and formatting effective prompts for both traditional LLMs and chat models.

groups.label: Output Parsing
groups.title: Structured Output Interpretation
groups.description: This group contains the interfaces and implementations for parsing raw language model outputs into structured and actionable data.
